_note: Frozen BEFORE the second and last test-split run. These are the rows the run will score, with the dev numbers they had at the freeze. Nothing is tuned after the commit that adds this file; bench/frameworks/run_test.py refuses to run unless this file is committed and unchanged and the log shows one earlier run. Dev quality was identical across repeated runs (the retrieval is deterministic).

how_chosen.cairn-*: the Phase 6 retrievers as they were (hybrid = min-max weighted fusion, the project default); not changed in Phase 11
how_chosen.li-default: LlamaIndex defaults (SentenceSplitter 1024/200, metadata kept, FAISS IndexFlatL2), with bge's query instruction and k = 10
how_chosen.li-md-code-30: the chunking selected on dev by the rule in candidates.json (see selected.json), vector search
how_chosen.li-bm25-*: LlamaIndex BM25 retriever on the default and on the selected chunking
how_chosen.li-fusion-default: default chunking, vector (FAISS L2, as documented) + BM25 by reciprocal-rank fusion; keeps the score-direction quirk found on dev
how_chosen.li-fusion-selected-ip: selected chunking, vector (FAISS inner product, which avoids the quirk) + BM25 by reciprocal-rank fusion; the IP index was added after seeing the L2 fusion fail on dev, not chosen by search

not_in_the_test_run: and the seven other chunking candidates (diagnostics and losing candidates, dev only)
test_questions: the 20 test questions (5 per category); one question is 0.05, so a gap under about 0.1 is noise
